$comment: Contract C9: the URL map of the developers host (PLAN.md §2.4) as data. Routes are listed in match order; the first match wins (so /docs/llms.txt is matched before /docs/<slug>). Each route lists one or more path patterns. Placeholders: <slug> one path segment, case-sensitive Unicode, percent-encoded on the wire; <rest> any remainder; <page_path> the path of any page (/docs/<slug>, /reference/<slug>, /page/<slug>). Status 200 means the resource itself; a redirect's target is the Location header, relative to the request's host unless absolute. Change only through the Integrator.

rules.no_api_prefix: No portal endpoint lives under /api/ (nginx sends /api/search/ to Elasticsearch, Varnish caches /api/ prefixes host-blind, ModuleMiddleware assigns /api/ to the library module). The only /api/ route on this host is the existing /api/powered-by view.
rules.case_sensitive: Paths are case-sensitive, as on live: /DOCS/WELCOME is a 404.
rules.caching: Everything except /api/ and /static/ passes through Varnish uncached, so publishing needs no purge.
rules.static: /static/ is served by nginx (every module server block aliases it); the portal references its bundle as same-origin /static/bundles/devportal/….
rules.markdown_negotiation: Every HTML page route also answers text/markdown when the request's Accept prefers text/markdown over text/html; such responses, and the HTML ones, carry Vary: Accept.
rules.headers: Every HTML and Markdown page response carries the Link header set of C10 (api-catalog, service-doc, agent-skills, mcp-server, alternate text/markdown) and Content-Language: en.
